title.narrative: Project to provide shelter and food assistance to those affected by floods in Bangladesh for the year 2024.

description.narrative: Securing and distributing 6,195 food baskets. Securing and building 630 shelters. Total beneficiaries of the project are approximately 34,125.

The project provides food baskets and shelter to those affected by floods in Bangladesh, with a total number of 34,125 beneficiaries. 1- The number of beneficiaries of food baskets is 30,975 individuals. 2- The number of beneficiaries of shelter is 3,150 individuals.
